summary: [[character:riker]] finds that about fifteen million [[species:human|humans]] remain on [[location:earth]] as worsening cold threatens their refuges. He and [[character:arthur]] improve contact with a hard-to-ignore holographic presentation, then convene a new [[organization:united-nations]] of survivor groups to decide its own governance rather than accept Riker's control. Riker rejects [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]]'s demand for preferential evacuation treatment. [[character:gudmund-valter]], leader of the Spitsbergen refuge, warns that its food outlook is worsening but reveals that its surviving seed and animal-genetics vaults could substantially improve future colonies.

introducing.name: United Nations
introducing.description: A new assembly of surviving human groups convened by [[character:riker]] to organize cooperation on [[species:human|humanity]]'s survival. Its delegates are to determine their own chairperson and meeting rules rather than accept Riker as their permanent authority.
introducing.current_state: Its first sessions have begun, and its delegates are working out their governance arrangements.

introducing.name: Gudmund Valter
introducing.current_state: Leading the Spitsbergen refuge while seeking survival and emigration assurances for its people.

updates.current_state: At [[location:sol]], organizing surviving [[location:earth]] enclaves into a [[organization:united-nations]] while continuing to coordinate their survival and eventual evacuation.

updates.state: About fifteen million people remain in scattered surviving enclaves. Less sunlight, falling temperatures, expanding snow and ice, and rough long-term projections of global glaciation make keeping those communities alive increasingly urgent.

updates.current_state: Its San Diego enclave seeks preferential evacuation treatment, but [[character:riker]] rejects the demand.
Its enclave outside Augsburg is expected to depart [[location:earth]] first because it supplied colony-ship plans, an arrangement opposed by many other survivor groups.

updates.description: GUPPI, the General Unit Primary Peripheral Interface, offloads tasks for replicants, who keep human limits on multitasking. Its operating system is firmware, so changing its replication priority would require a new core and ship. Version 2 has enough memory that a personality matrix is contemplated. It can act as a secretary, taking messages and arranging callbacks.

updates.current_state: The planned evacuation ships can move only a small fraction of [[location:earth]]'s survivors at a time, so most people must be kept alive on Earth while construction and destination planning continue.
